footnote_text: The shares subject to the restricted stock units (the "RSUs") vest over a period of six years, with 1/6 of such shares vesting in equal quarterly installments for the first year starting on November 15, 2026, and the remaining shares vesting in equal annual installments starting on November 15, 2027, subject to the employee's continued service to the Corporation through the applicable vesting dates. The shares will be delivered to the reporting person upon vesting of the RSUs. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock. || The amount reported includes shares subject to unvested restricted stock units.
